etymologies.heading: Etymology
paragraphs: Inherited from Middle English wynsom, winsom, winsome, winsum, wunsum (“beautiful; agreeable, gracious, pleasant; generous; of situations: favourable, propitious”), from Old English wynsum (“joyful, merry, pleasant; winsome”), from Proto-West Germanic *wunnjusam (“joyful”). By surface analysis, winne (“delight, joy, pleasure”) +‎ -some.
senses: Charming, engaging, winning; inspiring approval and trust, especially if in an innocent manner.
